==Details==
{{Quest details page|Making History}}

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Checklist|*Walk to or use the [[necklace of passage]] to teleport to the [[outpost]] north-west of Ardougne.
*Talk to [[Jorral]]. {{Chat option|1Tell me more.|1Ok, I'll make a stand for history!}}
*Complete the next 3 segments in any order.
}}

===Erin the silver merchant===
{{Map|2442,3139|mtype=square|r=4|align=right|width=250|height=250|caption=The location to dig for the chest.}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to the [[Silver merchant]] in the [[East Ardougne]] market. {{Chat option|2Ask about the outpost.}}
*Dig with your spade to find the [[Chest (Making History)|chest]] buried north of [[Castle Wars]].
*Open the chest with the [[enchanted key]] to get a journal.
}}

===Droalak the Ghost===
{{Checklist|
*Equip your [[Ghostspeak amulet]] and talk to [[Droalak]] outside the Port Phasmatys general store.
*In the building east of the general store, directly south of the pub, give [[Melina]] a strung sapphire amulet.
*Talk to Droalak to receive a scroll.
}}

===Dron the Warrior===
{{Checklist|*Go to [[Rellekka]] and talk to [[Blanin]] east of the longhall.
*Talk to [[Dron]] north of the longhall. {{Chat option|3I'm after important answers.|2Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!}} Answers:
**Quick answers: {{Chat option|2An iron mace|1Breakfast|2Lunch|1Bunnies|2Red|236|18|3Fifth and Fourth|3North East side of town|1Blanin|1Fluffy|112, but what does that have to do with anything?}}
**He wields an '''iron mace''' in battle. {{Chat option|2An iron mace}}
**He eats '''rats''' for '''breakfast'''. {{Chat option|1Breakfast}}
**He eats '''kittens''' for '''lunch'''. {{Chat option|2Lunch}}
**He eats '''bunnies''' for '''tea'''. {{Chat option|1Bunnies}}
**His favourite drink is '''red''' spider blood. {{Chat option|2Red}}
**He is '''36 years, 8 months (21 days) old.''' {{Chat option|236|18}}
**He studies the '''Fifth''' and '''Fourth''' ages. {{Chat option|3Fifth and Fourth}}
**His house is on the '''north-east side''' of town. {{Chat option|3North East side of town}}
**His brother's name is '''Blanin'''. {{Chat option|1Blanin}}
**His pet cat is named '''Fluffy'''. {{Chat option|1Fluffy}}
**5 plus 7 is '''12''' {{Chat option|112, but what does that have to do with anything?}}
}}

===Reporting back===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to Jorral, back at the outpost, with the scroll and journal.
*Talk to [[King Lathas]], located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Ardougne Castle]]. {{Chat option|1F}}
*Talk to Jorral, back at the outpost.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
